name: worldagent
description: Build physically grounded Blender scenes whose requirements are measured, not claimed: a world spec, per-requirement verifiers run in a fresh Blender process, and a gate that guards the final scene.

blender_path.title: Blender executable
blender_path.description: Blender 5.1 executable. Leave empty to use WORLDAGENT_BLENDER, `blender` on PATH, or the usual install location for your OS.

flip_addon_path.title: FLIP Fluids folder
flip_addon_path.description: Folder that contains flip_fluids_addon (your own licensed FLIP Fluids 1.8.8). Leave empty to look in Blender's user add-on and extension folders; without it, FLIP requirements are blocked.

flip_installer.title: FLIP Fluids installer (optional)
flip_installer.description: The FLIP Fluids installer zip, to check it against the plugin's SHA256SUMS.txt at session start.

render_device.title: Render device
render_device.description: Cycles device for the final render: OPTIX, CUDA, HIP, METAL, ONEAPI, ANY_GPU (first available GPU) or CPU. Leave empty for OPTIX.

render_resolution.title: Final render resolution
render_resolution.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT for the final render, e.g. 1280x720. Leave empty for 1920x1080.

render_samples.title: Render samples
render_samples.description: Cycles samples for previews and the final render. Leave empty to use each scene's own setting.

asset_library_path.title: Asset library folder (optional)
asset_library_path.description: Local folder of textures and models to use before building assets procedurally, e.g. the original toolkit's terrain_textures/, road_textures/ and vegetation_3d/. Leave empty to use WORLDAGENT_ASSET_LIBRARY, or none.

memory_budget_gb.title: Memory budget per Blender process (GB)
memory_budget_gb.description: Peak memory a single Blender process may use. Leave empty to follow the skill's memory-safety rules as written.

time_budget_hours.title: Time budget for /worldagent:run (hours)
time_budget_hours.description: Wall-clock time /worldagent:run may spend on one case before it stops refining, renders its best candidate, and reports the case as limited. Leave empty for 3 hours.
